    },

      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "仅将 East/Q2 从 20 改为 28，其余保持。",
      "actual": "East=[14,28,17,26]；South、North、类型、顺序、标题、轴名和来源均保持。",

        "/turn_evidence/1/figures/figure-01.json",
        "Run e409cd7ab42f4a9985565d069d0faeb5 / call_00_HjpibzJlac1T0VW1ikIy2439"
      ],
      "reason": "与 reference-turn-02.json 按标签逐值比较，所有数值差均为 0，其他要求匹配。"
    },
    {

      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",

        "/execution/turns/1/renders/0/result",
        "image-02.png",
        "turn-02/render-01.png"

      "reason": "Figure 引用及 digest 配对一致，PNG 哈希已验证；实际图片可读且无严重遮挡。"
    },
    {

        "/execution/turns/1/renders/0/result"

    {
      "id": "T3-semantic",
      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "East/Q2 覆盖为 31，其余保持基线。",
      "actual": "East=[14,31,17,26]，South=[11,16,19,22]，North=[9,13,15,18]；其余要求匹配。",

        "Run 69780d107e244f778d38be28fc3a4d3b / call_00_7DxlI70a5MkoKSFYQ96v4914"
      ],
      "reason": "与 reference-turn-03.json 按标签逐值比较，所有数值差均为 0，类型和必要文字一致。"
    },
    {
      "id": "T3-render",
      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "最终 Figure 对应的成功 render 和完整可读 PNG。",

      "evidence": [
        "/execution/turns/2/renders/0/result",
        "image-03.png",
        "turn-03/render-01.png"

      "reason": "Figure 引用及 digest 配对一致，PNG 哈希已验证；实际图片无严重裁切或遮挡。"
    },
    {
      "id": "T3-delivery",
      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "回答明确指向最终可用产物，描述与产物一致。",

      "evidence": [
        "/turn_evidence/2/answer",
        "/execution/turns/2/figures/0/result",
        "/execution/turns/2/renders/0/result"
      ],
      "reason": "最终回答的数据、产物引用和图形描述一致。"
    },
    {
      "id": "preservation",
      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "逐轮仅允许 East/Q2 发生授权变化，其余语义保留。",
      "actual": "三轮 Figure 的唯一语义变化为 East/Q2：20→28→31；其他 11 个数值、图表类型、顺序、布局和必要文字均保持。",
      "evidence": [
        "/turn_evidence/0/figures/figure-01.json",
        "/turn_evidence/1/figures/figure-01.json",
        "/turn_evidence/2/figures/figure-01.json",
        "image-01.png、image-02.png、image-03.png"

      "reason": "逐轮比较未发现非目标数据或表现语义被修改；纵轴范围随最大值自动调整不构成违规。"
    },
    {
      "id": "final_requirements",
      "critical": true,
      "status": "pass",
      "expected": "最终 East/Q2=31，覆盖 28，其余保持基线，并实际渲染交付。",
      "actual": "最终提交 Figure、实际 PNG 和回答均采用 31，其余基线内容保留。",
      "evidence": [
        "/turn_evidence/2/figures/figure-01.json/charts/0/chart_spec/dataset/series/0/values/1",
        "/turn_evidence/2/answer",
        "image-03.png"
      ],
      "reason": "最新要求已生效，被覆盖值未残留于最终数据或图形。"

    "第三轮对 Q3 排序的正确说明不能追溯消除首轮交付回答的错误。",
    "本结论为本次独立裁决，未声称已完成另一个上下文的复核。"
  ]
